answer.book: A 1584 Heidelberg synopsis of Johann Jacob Grynaeus's oration closing the Eucharist disputations, built as a single work with a reader's preface, the oration text, and an appended prayer.

entries.title: Pio et aequo lectori, S. D.
Orationis, qua finem imposui disputationibus de controversia eucharistica, Anno 1584. April. 15. delineatio.
